title: Wormholes
synopsis: As well as sci-fi novels, descriptions of wormholes can be found in ancient Chinese texts.

fullText.simplified:
虫洞

    “虫洞”又叫“时空洞”。物理学家爱因斯坦认为“虫洞”就是连接宇宙遥远区域间的时空细管。暗物质维持着虫洞出口的开启。虫洞可以把平行宇宙和婴儿宇宙连接起来，并提供时间旅行的可能性。
    但是，虫洞真的存在吗？
    科学家们一直在通过各种方式寻找“虫洞”，但是由于技术和客观条件的限制，至今还一直处于理论阶段。即使有所发现，也无法真正找到和到达。
    值得注意的是，中国的很多古籍中，也有关于“虫洞”的描述，有进入“虫洞”后穿越的故事。
    比如，汉朝时期发生过这样一件事。当时一个村子里突发瘟疫，两名年轻人一起前往当地的天台山采药给村民们治病。但是，因为路远，而且地方比较偏僻，这两人迷路了。他们只能一直往前走。走着走着他们遇见了两个美女，这两个美女把小伙子们带回了家，拿出好吃的好喝的招待他们。后来这两个人稀里糊涂地就跟两个美女结了婚。一年后，两个小伙子太想回家了，于是他们在妻子的指引下下了山。但是下山后的两人找了半天都没有找到自己的村子。后来才知道，他们二人早就成为了当地人口中的“先祖”，在几百年前上山采药后就失踪了。原来，他们在山上一年的时间，人间已经过去了几百年！最后，没办法，他们俩人只好又回到了山上。
    不管是科学研究还是古籍记载，人们对于“虫洞”的好奇和探索的热情一直很高。希望随着科学技术的不断发展，科学家们能够真正找到“虫洞”，“时空旅行”不再只出现在电影或者科幻小说中。
fullText.traditional:
蟲洞

    “蟲洞”又叫“時空洞”。物理學家愛因斯坦認為“蟲洞”就是連接宇宙遙遠區域間的時空細管。暗物質維持著蟲洞出口的開啟。蟲洞可以把平行宇宙和嬰兒宇宙連接起來，並提供時間旅行的可能性。
    但是，蟲洞真的存在嗎？
    科學家們一直在通過各種方式尋找“蟲洞”，但是由於技術和客觀條件的限制，至今還一直處於理論階段。即使有所發現，也無法真正找到和到達。
    值得注意的是，中國的很多古籍中，也有關於“蟲洞”的描述，有進入“蟲洞”後穿越的故事。
    比如，漢朝時期發生過這樣一件事。當時一個村子裡突發瘟疫，兩名年輕人一起前往當地的天台山採藥給村民們治病。但是，因為路遠，而且地方比較偏僻，這兩人迷路了。他們只能一直往前走。走著走著他們遇見了兩個美女，這兩個美女把小伙子們帶回了家，拿出好吃的好喝的招待他們。後來這兩個人稀裏糊塗地就跟兩個美女結了婚。一年後，兩個小伙子太想回家了，於是他們在妻子的指引下下了山。但是下山後的兩人找了半天都沒有找到自己的村子。後來才知道，他們二人早就成為了當地人口中的“先祖”，在幾百年前上山採藥後就失蹤了。原來，他們在山上一年的時間，人間已經過去了幾百年！最後，沒辦法，他們倆人只好又回到了山上。
    不管是科學研究還是古籍記載，人們對於“蟲洞”的好奇和探索的熱情一直很高。希望隨著科學技術的不斷發展，科學家們能夠真正找到“蟲洞”，“時空旅行”不再只出現在電影或者科幻小說中。

sentences.traditional: 物理學家愛因斯坦認為“蟲洞”就是連接宇宙遙遠區域間的時空細管。

sentences.english: Physicist Albert Einstein believed that “wormholes” are thin tunnels in spacetime that connect remote regions of the universe.

sentences.simplified: 虫洞可以把平行宇宙和婴儿宇宙连接起来，并提供时间旅行的可能性。
sentences.traditional: 蟲洞可以把平行宇宙和嬰兒宇宙連接起來，並提供時間旅行的可能性。
sentences.pinyin: chóng dòng kě yǐ bǎ píng xíng yǔ zhòu hé yīng ér yǔ zhòu lián jiē qǐ lái bìng tí gōng shí jiān lǚ xíng de kě néng xìng
sentences.english: Dark matter allows for wormhole exits to open.
Wormholes can connect parallel universes and baby universes and also offer the possibility of time travel.

sentences.traditional: 但是，蟲洞真的存在嗎？

sentences.english: However, do wormholes really exist?

sentences.english: Scientists have been continuously searching for “wormholes” using various methods.

sentences.simplified: 即使有所发现，也无法真正找到和到达。
sentences.traditional: 即使有所發現，也無法真正找到和到達。

sentences.english: However, due to limitations in technology and objective factors, wormholes have remained at the stage of theory until now.
Even if there are discoveries, there is no way to truly find them or reach them.

sentences.traditional: 有進入“蟲洞”後穿越的故事。

sentences.english: It’s worth noting that there have also been descriptions of “wormholes” in many ancient Chinese texts.
There are stories of entering “wormholes” and then traveling through time.

sentences.english: For example, such an incident happened in the Han Dynasty.

sentences.traditional: 兩名年輕人一起前往當地的天台山採藥給村民們治病。

sentences.english: At the time, there was a village that was suddenly struck by a plague.

sentences.simplified: 但是，因为路远，而且地方比较偏僻，这两人迷路了。
sentences.traditional: 但是，因為路遠，而且地方比較偏僻，這兩人迷路了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì yīn wèi lù yuǎn ér qiě dì fang bǐ jiào piān pì zhè liǎng rén mí lù le
sentences.english: Two young men went to the local Mount Tiantai to collect medicine in order to cure the villagers.

sentences.simplified: 他们只能一直往前走。走着走着他们遇见了两个美女，
sentences.traditional: 他們只能一直往前走。走著走著他們遇見了兩個美女，
sentences.pinyin: tā men zhǐ néng yì zhí wǎng qián zǒu zǒu zhe zǒu zhe tā men yù jiàn le liǎng ge měi nǚ
sentences.english: However, because the journey was far and the area was remote, the two men got lost.

sentences.simplified: 这两个美女把小伙子们带回了家，拿出好吃的好喝的招待他们。
sentences.traditional: 這兩個美女把小伙子們帶回了家，拿出好吃的好喝的招待他們。
sentences.pinyin: zhè liǎng ge měi nǚ bǎ xiǎo huǒ zi men dài huí le jiā ná chū hǎo chī de hǎo hē de zhāo dài tā men
sentences.english: They could only keep walking ahead. As they were walking, they encountered two beautiful women.

sentences.simplified: 后来这两个人稀里糊涂地就跟两个美女结了婚。
sentences.traditional: 後來這兩個人稀裏糊塗地就跟兩個美女結了婚。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái zhè liǎng ge rén xī li hú tu de jiù gēn liǎng ge měi nǚ jié le hūn
sentences.english: These two beautiful women brought the young men home and served them good food and drink.

sentences.simplified: 一年后，两个小伙子太想回家了，
sentences.traditional: 一年後，兩個小伙子太想回家了，
sentences.pinyin: yì nián hòu liǎng ge xiǎo huǒ zi tài xiǎng huí jiā le
sentences.english: Later, the two men muddleheadedly married these two beautiful women.

sentences.simplified: 于是他们在妻子的指引下下了山。
sentences.traditional: 於是他們在妻子的指引下下了山。
sentences.pinyin: yú shì tā men zài qī zi de zhǐ yǐn xià xià le shān
sentences.english: A year later, the two young men really wanted to go home.

sentences.simplified: 但是下山后的两人找了半天都没有找到自己的村子。
sentences.traditional: 但是下山後的兩人找了半天都沒有找到自己的村子。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì xià shān hòu de liǎng rén zhǎo le bàn tiān dōu méi yǒu zhǎo dào zì jǐ de cūn zi
sentences.english: So, with the guidance of their wives, they descended the mountain.

sentences.simplified: 后来才知道，他们二人早就成为了当地人口中的“先祖”，
sentences.traditional: 後來才知道，他們二人早就成為了當地人口中的“先祖”，
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái cái zhī dào tā men èr rén zǎo jiù chéng wéi le dāng dì rén kǒu zhōng de xiān zǔ
sentences.english: However, after descending the mountain, the two men searched for a long time but could not find their village.

sentences.simplified: 在几百年前上山采药后就失踪了。
sentences.traditional: 在幾百年前上山採藥後就失蹤了。
sentences.pinyin: zài jǐ bǎi nián qián shàng shān cǎi yào hòu jiù shī zōng le
sentences.english: Only later did the two men find out that they had long become known as “ancestors” of the local people.

sentences.simplified: 原来，他们在山上一年的时间，人间已经过去了几百年！
sentences.traditional: 原來，他們在山上一年的時間，人間已經過去了幾百年！
sentences.pinyin: yuán lái tā men zài shān shang yì nián de shí jiān rén jiān yǐ jīng guò qù le jǐ bǎi nián
sentences.english: Several hundred years previously, they had disappeared after going up the mountain to collect medicine.

sentences.simplified: 最后，没办法，他们俩人只好又回到了山上。
sentences.traditional: 最後，沒辦法，他們倆人只好又回到了山上。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu méi bàn fǎ tā men liǎ rén zhǐ hǎo yòu huí dào le shān shang
sentences.english: It turned out that during the one year that they spent on the mountain, several hundred years had passed on earth!
Finally, the two men had no choice but to return to the mountain.

sentences.english: Whether it’s scientific research or ancient records, ..

sentences.traditional: 希望隨著科學技術的不斷發展，科學家們能夠真正找到“蟲洞”，

sentences.english: .. people’s curiosity about and eagerness to explore “wormholes” has always been very high.

sentences.simplified: “时空旅行”不再只出现在电影或者科幻小说中。
sentences.traditional: “時空旅行”不再只出現在電影或者科幻小說中。

sentence_translations: Wormholes
“Wormholes” are also called “spacetime holes” in Chinese.
Physicist Albert Einstein believed that “wormholes” are thin tunnels in spacetime that connect remote regions of the universe.
Dark matter allows for wormhole exits to open.
Wormholes can connect parallel universes and baby universes and also offer the possibility of time travel.
However, do wormholes really exist?
Scientists have been continuously searching for “wormholes” using various methods.
However, due to limitations in technology and objective factors, wormholes have remained at the stage of theory until now.
Even if there are discoveries, there is no way to truly find them or reach them.
It’s worth noting that there have also been descriptions of “wormholes” in many ancient Chinese texts.
There are stories of entering “wormholes” and then traveling through time.
For example, such an incident happened in the Han Dynasty.
At the time, there was a village that was suddenly struck by a plague.
Two young men went to the local Mount Tiantai to collect medicine in order to cure the villagers.
However, because the journey was far and the area was remote, the two men got lost.
They could only keep walking ahead. As they were walking, they encountered two beautiful women.
These two beautiful women brought the young men home and served them good food and drink.
Later, the two men muddleheadedly married these two beautiful women.
A year later, the two young men really wanted to go home.
So, with the guidance of their wives, they descended the mountain.
However, after descending the mountain, the two men searched for a long time but could not find their village.
Only later did the two men find out that they had long become known as “ancestors” of the local people.
Several hundred years previously, they had disappeared after going up the mountain to collect medicine.
It turned out that during the one year that they spent on the mountain, several hundred years had passed on earth!
Finally, the two men had no choice but to return to the mountain.
Whether it’s scientific research or ancient records, ..
.. people’s curiosity about and eagerness to explore “wormholes” has always been very high.
Hopefully, with the continuous development of science and technology, scientists will truly be able to find “wormholes”, ..
.. and “time travel” will no longer only exist in movies or sci-fi novels.
